title: The client portal looks and works differently inside the new iPhone app
text: Only inside the new MyLLC Manager app (the website is unchanged), the portal has its own frame: a round Menu button at the top right, no website sidebar, and a company chooser on the Overview. Chat has one Topic button and opens on the newest unread answer, with no Journey Log. Invoices opens on a list of areas with tappable set-up steps, TD Billing is its own screen, and the Pay Invoice pop-up works inside the app.
points: The Menu button stays at the top while the page scrolls, and its red number counts waiting items that are not in the bottom bar.
Pay Now leaves in the app's own window, and the card page returns the client to TD Billing.
A switch can hide Pay inside the app if Apple objects. The website is never affected.
Paying inside the app had not been tried with a real card on a real phone yet.
